label: Repair configuration syntax and Fusion permission interfaces
instruction: Mechanical build repair only to existing api/configuration.py. Its indentation before module-level save_configuration and record_view is invalid; HasModuleGrant and HasPermission are class factories for DRF permission_classes, not decorators. Adapt to supplied interfaces: remove invalid decorators, use permission_classes on the existing ConfigurationView/RecordListView with module leave_elm and the existing configuration.manage/record.manage names. Add missing existing Response, LeaveHistory and LeaveNotification imports. The referenced LeaveHistorySerializer and LeaveNotificationSerializer are absent: add those two simple ModelSerializer classes using fields="__all__" in the same configuration.py file before the views. Preserve all existing queryset filters, function bodies, save arguments and response behavior; do not repair business or query logic. Return the entire configuration.py only, max100 lines.
